current.name: Winter 2026 Research Forum
current.format: Online. Finalists present live to a panel of economics professors, followed by Q&A.
current.eligibility: High school and university students from any country. Individual and team submissions welcome.
themes: Labor migration to Russia, Korea, the Gulf and Europe

rubric.description: Is the question clear, focused and relevant to migration or remittances in Central Asia?
Are the data appropriate and the method sound, transparent and honestly reported?
Does the work tell us something new or useful, with conclusions that follow from the evidence?
Is the presentation clear, and does the presenter handle questions from the judges well?

awards: Certificates for all finalists and winners
Publication of the strongest papers as an SREI Working Paper
A mentorship session for the 1st place winner
current.howToSubmit: Submit your paper or extended abstract through the submission form. You will receive a confirmation by email.
